title: Finance for degree-granting public institutions using GASB Reporting Standards
note:
Part A - Statement of Net Assets
Line Category
1 - Total current assets
31 - Depreciable capital assets, net of depreciation.
4 - Other noncurrent assets (Do not include in import file. Will be generated)
5 - Total noncurrent assets
6 - Total assets (Do not include in import file. Will be generated)
19 - Deferred outflows of resources
7 - Long-term debt, current portion
8 - Other current liabilities (Do not include in import file. Will be generated)
9 - Total current liabilities
10 - Long-term debt
11 - Other non-current liabilities (Do not include in import file. Will be generated as follows: Line 12 minus line 10.)

18 - Net position (Do not include in import file. Will be generated as follows: (Line 6 plus Line 19) minus (line 13 plus Line 20))

27 - Construction in progress

Part D - Summary of Changes in Net Position

1 - Total revenues and other additions
2 - Total expenses and deductions
3 - Change in net position (Do not include in import file. Will be generated as follows: Line 1 minus line 2)

5 - Adjustments to beginning net position (Do not include in import file. Will be generated as follows: Line 6 minus sum of lines 3 and 4)
6 - Net position end of year (Do not include in import file. Will be generated from Part A line 18)

nameFl:
IPEDS 2025-26 Import Specifications: Finance for degree-granting public institutions using GASB Reporting Standards
Applies to: Degree-granting institutions
File type: Fixed Length/Positional (*.txt)
noteFL:
Note: All numeric fields should be right-justified. Both leading zeros and spaces are permissible. Character data should be left justified.
If there is a zero amount for any finance category, the line does not have to be included in the import file.
